title_sq: Hotel per shitje ne zonen e kombinatit

Shitet Hotel ne zonen e kombinatit.
Hoteli ndodhet ne rrugen kryesore Tirane Ndroq.
Siperfaqe trualli 1690 m²
Siperfaqe ndertimi 1770 m²
Ndertese 4 kateshe me nje kat ne -1
Kati -1 funksionon si ambient per sherbimet e Hotelit (Depo uji, pompat e objektit, kaldaja dhe lavanteria) sherben dhe si parking per makina
Objekti esht i pajisur me ashensor nga kati -1 deri ne tarrace
Kati 0 eshte I ndare ne dy ambiente, restorant dhe bar kafe

Te gjitha nevojat per energji elektrike furnizohen me panel diellor i cili eshte investim I dy viteve te fundit
title_en: Hotel for sale in the combine area
description_en: Hotel for sale in the area of ​​the combine. The hotel is located on the main road Tirana Ndroq. Land area 1690 m² Construction area 1770 m² 4-storey building with one floor in -1 Floor -1 functions as a facility for the Hotel's services (water tank, facility pumps, boiler and laundry) also serves as a car park The facility is equipped with an elevator from floor -1 to the terrace Floor 0 is divided into two rooms, a restaurant and a coffee bar Floor 1,2 and 3 serve as a hotel with a total capacity of 27 rooms, three of which are suites. The surfaces of the rooms vary from 25 m², 27 m² and 30 m² The front and back of the hotel serve as a parking lot for the restaurant and the hotel All electricity needs are supplied by a solar panel which is an investment of the last two years
